decisions.question: SDD pre-flight for nidana.model.14 (spot-check): which model implements each task?

options.label: Sonnet for every task
options.consequence: The run's rule for non-full-review phases; the plan's code and tests were dry-run.

options.label: Opus for the renderers
options.consequence: More capable on the escaping rules; departs from the run's rule.

decisions.why: The run's model rule; the plan's code blocks are spliced from the dry run (docs/auto-run/experiments/renderers-plan/).
evidence: docs/auto-run/impl-execution-plan.md How a phase runs item 3

decisions.question: test/topology_graph_test.dart's header comment says the G22 render case waits for nidana.model.14's Mermaid renderer; the plan edits no existing test. Fix the comment in this phase?

options.label: Task 2 rewords the comment sentence
options.consequence: A one-sentence comment edit in a shipped test, no behavior change; the comment stays true.

options.label: Leave it
options.consequence: The comment misleads a reader once the renderers land.

decisions.why: Task 2 is the task that makes the G22 render case pass; the edit is a comment only.

decisions.question: Task 3's review found the doc overstating Task 1's review evidence (from the controller's own dispatch) and five minors, one of them a sixth replay gap no Learning names. Which go into the fix round?

options.label: The Important, three minors and a third Learning
options.consequence: The owner-signed doc states the evidence, the cases turned green, the ruling names and every replay gap accurately; the type-name gap is routed to the sweep.

options.label: The Important only
options.consequence: Smaller edit; the doc keeps an unnamed replay gap and minor inaccuracies.

decisions.chosen: The Important, three minors and a third Learning
decisions.why: The verification doc is what the owner signs; the type-name gap is a real coverage gap of topology-ir@v1's samples, so it belongs in the sweep entry with S149's five. Lines 14 and 66 are brief-mandated wording and stay.

decisions.question: nidana.model.14's final review says ready to merge with one fix: the doc's 'fix rounds: none' is false after Task 3's doc round. Run the final fix wave on that only, and route the Graphviz empty-cluster note?

options.label: Doc-only wave on the fix-round line; route the empty-cluster note to the topology-ir@v1 sweep
options.consequence: The signed doc states every fix round; the contract-level drawing issue goes to hsdd-contract with the other renderer coverage gaps.

options.label: Also refactor the id formats
options.consequence: A library change after review with no behavior change; every golden already pins both spellings.

decisions.chosen: Doc-only wave on the fix-round line; route the empty-cluster note to the topology-ir@v1 sweep
decisions.why: The reviewer triaged every other deferred finding as can-wait; the empty-cluster behavior follows the contract's rule, so only the contract can change it.
